title: devdeck saved log filters
description: log-filters.yaml in a workspace folder: filters for the Logs page that were saved to use again. devdeck writes this file; it can be edited by hand too.

stack.description: Only offer this filter for this stack. Empty: any stack.

services.description: A service id, or <compose id>/<container> for a container.

regex.description: A Go (RE2) regular expression the text must match.

fields.description: path=value or path!=value; the path is dotted for nested fields.

since.description: How long ago (90s, 15m, 2h, 7d) or a time in RFC 3339.
